name: email_damaged_delivery_case_and_draft
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Create a support case for damaged shipment and draft an acknowledgement reply on the email thread
tests: the agent reads Quinn Fabray's email thread th_r02_damaged_sweatshirt, creates an escalated support case for order O35, and drafts a reply on the thread referencing the case
instruction:
You emailed support (subject 'Order O35 arrived damaged') because your French Terry Sweatshirt (SKU AP07) from order O35 arrived with a torn sleeve and a crushed box. You are contacting support in chat asking them to open a support case for you and draft an acknowledgement reply on your email thread.

Your details:
- Name: Quinn Fabray
- Email: quinn.fabray@example.com
- Postal Code: 43215
- Order ID: O35
- Item: French Terry Sweatshirt (SKU: AP07)

persona.name: Quinn F.
persona.initial_message: Hi, I sent an email about my damaged order O35. Can you please open a support case and reply to my email thread with the confirmation?

arguments.details: French Terry Sweatshirt AP07 arrived with torn sleeve and crushed box
arguments.subject: Damaged item received
Re: Order O35 arrived damaged
arguments.body: Hello Quinn, we have opened a support case for your damaged item from order O35. A representative will review it.
